issues.description: Spec calc_excess_blob_gas takes only parent.excess_blob_gas and parent.blob_gas_used and TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK, with no base-fee input. Implementation passes parentHeader.getBaseFee().orElse(Wei.ZERO).toLong() as third argument and delegates to getGasLimitCalculator().computeExcessBlobGas(). This is wrong abstraction and wrong parameter: base-fee must not influence excess calculation.
issues.potential_impact: If underlying calculator uses base-fee, excess_blob_gas will diverge from spec, causing incorrect blob base-fee, invalid header validation (excess_blob_gas mismatch) and consensus split / chain fork. Use of GasLimitCalculator risks fork-config confusion (pre-Cancun vs Cancun).
issues.spec_reference: def calc_excess_blob_gas(parent: Header) -> int: if parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used < TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK: return 0 else: return parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK
issues.suggestion: Implement formula directly in this function: excess = parentExcess + parentUsed; return 0 if excess < TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (393216) else excess - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK. Do not pass base_fee. Reference Cancun blob parameters, not GasLimitCalculator.

issues.description: Header fields blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas are defined as 64-bit unsigned integers. Implementation converts to signed Java long and back without unsigned handling or non-negativity check. Excess is unbounded running total and can exceed 2^63-1; signed long will overflow to negative.
issues.potential_impact: Overflow / negative excess leads to wrong get_base_fee_per_blob_gas via fake_exponential, under-pricing blob gas, DoS / consensus failure if BlobGas.of accepts negative or wraps.
issues.spec_reference: blob_gas_used is the total amount of blob gas consumed by the transactions within the block. - excess_blob_gas is a running total of blob gas consumed in excess of the target, prior to the block.
issues.suggestion: Use unsigned 64-bit handling (e.g., BlobGas/UInt64 arithmetic, Long.compareUnsigned, check overflow) and assert result >=0. Do not truncate via toLong without validation.

verification.matched_excerpt: blob_gas_used is the total amount of blob gas consumed by the transactions within the block. - excess_blob_gas is a running total of blob gas consumed in excess of the target, prior to the block.

summary: File only covers excess_blob_gas update and correctly defaults missing parent fields to 0 for first post-fork block, but delegates core formula to GasLimitCalculator with an extraneous base-fee argument not in spec and uses signed long for uint64 values. Correctness cannot be verified without the delegated calculator and divergence would cause consensus failure.
